data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Pietrocola that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private firms in Robotics & Manufacturing (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics) alongside one public comparable, though the public peer set is limited.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, using the $5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient datapoints in the narrow same-stage and adjacent-stage peer set within Robotics & Manufacturing; while 11 same-sector peers exist broadly, fewer than three comparables met tighter filtering criteria, making median-based triangulation unreliable.

The triangulated range is $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M, derived from the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the narrow peer set for cross-validation and limited public market data for this subsector. The $5M raised proxy introduces some friction as a valuation anchor—actual pre-money may differ. This range should be treated as preliminary pending deeper institutional investor signal or audited financials that could support or refute the stage-based step-up assumption.
